original_ai_output.title_zh: CISLAC等机构呼吁加强安全行动中防范性暴力的举报与措施
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚公民社会立法倡导中心（CISLAC）及其他利益相关方在阿布贾举行全国多利益相关方政策对话，呼吁在国防和安全机构中采取更强措施防止性暴力和性别暴力（SGBV）。与会者指出，恐惧报复、污名化和缺乏信任导致受害者不愿举报，强调需加强预防、安全举报和机构问责。

key_facts.fact: CISLAC等利益相关方呼吁在国防和安全机构中加强防范性暴力和性别暴力的措施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Civil Society Legislative Advocacy Centre (CISLAC) and other stakeholders have called for stronger measures to prevent Sexual and Gender-based Violence (SGBV) within Nigeria’s defence and security institutions.

key_facts.fact: CISLAC执行主任在阿布贾全国政策对话上发出呼吁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: CISLAC Executive Director, Mr Auwal Rafsanjani, made the call on Tuesday in Abuja at a national multi-stakeholder policy dialogue.

key_facts.fact: ICPC官员表示打击性暴力和性别暴力的主要挑战是漏报
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mrs Peace Arocha, Deputy Director, Legal Services Department, Independent Corrupt Practices and other Related Offenses Commission (ICPC), said the major challenge in the fight against SGBV was underreporting.

key_facts.fact: 国家人权委员会表示性暴力和性别暴力仍是不安全的后果，有时也是安全应对的特征
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) Executive Secretary, Dr Tony Ojukwu who also spoke said SGBV remained a consequence of insecurity and, sometimes, a feature of security responses, threatening human rights and public trust.
